crime: The tallest girl, who had the quickest hands in the prison, had been {WITCH_NAME}'s only friend. She alone knew about the shaking hands and dry heaves after every fight.

After a corridor fight, the tall girl brought the others around the corner to watch. By evening they were mocking {WITCH_NAME}. The tall girl began shoving her in the meal queue and flicking her ear. One night she promised everyone another show at breakfast.

{WITCH_NAME} waited alone in the entrance hall before breakfast and repeated the confidence word for word when the tall girl arrived. The girl lunged with all her weight behind a punch. {WITCH_NAME}'s fist reached her jaw first, throwing her backward onto the stone. Her skull broke in the fall.

The body lay by the doors, its jaw bruised and one fist still half closed. {WITCH_NAME} said she had come up with the others, but an early riser had seen her cross the hall alone. At breakfast, her right knuckles were freshly split.
fields.epitaph: No fist was fast enough to take back a word.
fields.epithet: The Fist That Could Not Hide a Tremor
execution: Iron stocks held her kneeling, with her fists clamped at her sides and her chin braced forward. Before her, an iron arm clicked and struck her face with an open hand. It repeated at regular intervals, each blow visible from start to finish. The arm was still striking after her body stopped moving.

magic.name: First Fist
magic.text: When someone moves to punch her, her fist lands first.
